entry.name: filterdesign
entry.description: Use the filterdesign object to create a dictionary containing a specification for a filter that can be realized by several other objects including the cascade~ object.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.digest: Cutoff frequency/frequencies
attributes.description: Filter cutoff frequencies specified in units defined by theattribute. For lowpass and highpass filters a single frequency will be used to define the cutoff. For bandpass and bandstop filters two frequencies are required.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: name
attributes.digest: Name to which the output dictionary is bound

attributes.name: order
attributes.digest: Order of the filter
attributes.description: The order of the filter, which is to say the number of poles and zeroes. For reference, theobject is a second-order filter (2 poles and 2 zeroes).

attributes.name: passband_ripple
attributes.digest: Magnitude ripple in Chebyshev Type 1 filter passband
attributes.description: Magnitude ripple in the passband for Chebyshev Type 1 filters in decibels. Higher amounts of ripple will provide a narrower transition band given a constant order for the filter.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: response
attributes.digest: Filter response shape

choices.digest: Low frequencies pass through, high frequencies are attenuated
High frequencies pass through, low frequencies are attenuated
A band of frequencies pass through, low and high frequencies are attenuated
A band of frequencies are attenuated, low and high frequencies pass through

attributes.name: samplerate
attributes.digest: Samplerate used whenattribute is set to hertz
attributes.description: Samplerate used whenattribute is set to hertz. If the samplerate is set to zero then MSP's samplerate will be used.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: sos_output
attributes.digest: Inclusion of coefficients for second-order-sections in the output dictionary
attributes.description: Inclusion of coefficients for second-order-sections in the output dictionary. This is the native format used by,, and.

attributes.name: stopband_attenuation
attributes.digest: Minimum attenuation in Chebyshev Type 2 filter stopband
attributes.description: Minimum attenuation in Chebyshev Type 2 filter stopband in decibels. For given order of filter, greater attenuation results in a wider transition band and less attenuation in the stopband results in a narrower transition band.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: tf_output
attributes.digest: Include single-section transfer function coefficients in the output dictionary
attributes.description: Include single-section transfer function coefficients in the output dictionary. This representation works well for low-ordered filters but quickly becomes subject to floating-point precision roundoff as the order of the filter increases.

attributes.name: topology
attributes.digest: Organization of the zeroes and poles used to realize the filter
attributes.description: The organization of the zeroes and poles used to realize the filter.

choices.digest: Gentle transition, flat passband, monotonically decreasing stopband
Steepest transition, definable ripple in passband, monotonically decreasing stopband
Moderate transition, flat passband, definable ripple in the stopband

attributes.name: units
attributes.digest: Units of measurement for specifying frequencies

choices.digest: Cycles per second, based on theattribute
Range from 0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 is the nyquist frequency
Range from 0.0 to pi; pi is the nyquist frequency

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: zpk_output
attributes.digest: Include zeroes-poles-gain representation in the output dictionary
attributes.description: Include zeroes-poles-gain representation in the output dictionary. Zeroes-poles-gain (ZPK) provides a more accurate representation of the filter's response than the single-section transfer function (seeattribute) for higher-order filters. If calculating coefficients for second-order-sections (seeattribute) the ZPK representation is calculated as an intermediary stage.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double-click theobject to open a dictionary editor window and view or edit the current attributes.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Generate filterdesign dictionary using current attributes and output it
messages.description: Sending awill generate the filterdesign dictionary using current attributes and send it out the first outlet.
